title: Resolve 'digest' term redefinition conflict in Conventions
description: §1.1 (lines 88-91) redefines 'digest' to mean specifically 'SHA-256 hash encoded as lowercase hex'. But the word 'digest' appears in §1 (line 69-70) and §2.2 (line 162) to describe JMAP-BLOBEXT's digest:sha-256, which is base64-encoded. Those uses contradict the Conventions definition. Options: (1) rename the concept in this document (e.g. 'hex digest' or 'CID value'), or (2) remove the blanket redefinition and be explicit each time.
